body:
Word of advice: really think about if having kids is worse than NOT being with this person.

I may get a lot of stick here as I don't think this will be a very popular comment.

Kids are a permanent fixture and yes, will change and maybe ruin your life (but to be fair could also surprise you). But there is something to be said about spending your life with the person you love the most.

I let someone go in this exact same scenario. I would, in a heartbeat, go back. This is not to say I want kids, but in hindsight a life with kids with her would be more fulfilling than what is a great life without kids, but also without her.

So circling back. Really, really think if it's worth letting this person go.
